about: LEN-07, Python example forms, app caps. A Google Examples: section with blank-separated doctests, a '::' literal block and a bare >>> doctest (whose output is '') each take a docstring over the cap of 10 only when counted, so none is listed. The Example: section that ends at prose indented no deeper than its heading leaves that prose, and the blank line before it, counted: 11 lines, listed.
